book.name: Taalie
book.title: Ala xa Taalie Ala xa Taalie

content.text: Xili fanyi fan naafuli bɛ,
binyɛ tide dangi xɛɛma nun gbeti tide ra.
Banna nun setare birin lan,
barima Alatala nan e birin daa.
Xaxilima na fe xɔrɔxɔɛ to, a a yɛtɛ nan natangama a ma.
Xaxilitare tan na fe xɔrɔxɔɛ to, a soma a kui nɛ keren na,
a fa ɲaxankatɛ sɔtɔ.
Yɛtɛ magore naxan gaaxuma Alatala ya ra,
a bannaya, binyɛ, nun simaya sɔtɔma nɛ.
Tunbee nun gantanyie na tinxintare xa kira xɔn ma,
kɔnɔ mixi naxan mɛɛnima a yɛtɛ ma, a a makuyama nɛ mɛnni ra.
Fonike matinxin kira fanyi ra,
alako a naxa gbilen na fɔxɔ ra a mɔ tɛmui.
Banna setare yamarima nɛ,
doni tongoe fan findi donifa xa konyi ra.
Mixi ɲaaxi tɔɔrɛ nan sɔtɔma a sare ra,
a sɛnbɛ fama nɛ kanade.
Hinnɛnte barakama nɛ,
barima a tɔɔrɔmixie kima a xa donse ra.
Mixi mayoe keri, alako ɲɔxɔnsɔsɔɛ xa ɲɔn.
Na tɛmui gbɛsɛnxɔnnɛya nun konbie danma nɛ.
Bɔɲɛ xa sɛniyɛnyi rafan mixi naxan ma,
wɔyɛn fanyie nan minima na dɛ i,
a fa findi mangɛ dɛfanboore ra.
Alatala nɔndi nan makantama,
kɔnɔ a yanfante xa wɔyɛnyi xun nakanama nɛ.
Mixi tunnaxɔnɔxi nan a falama,
«Yɛtɛ xaaɲɛxi na tande, n na mini kɛnɛ ma, a n faxama nɛ.»
Gantanyi nan na langoe ginɛ xa wɔyɛnyi ra.
Alatala xɔnɔxi mixi naxan ma, na suxuma na gantanyi kui.
Xaxilitareɲa naxan na dimɛdi bɔɲɛ kui,
a bama xuru luxusinyi nan saabui ra.
Mixi naxan setare tɔɔrɔma geeni nde xa fe ra,
nun mixi naxan banna kima,
na firinyi findima fuxarila nan na.
I i tuli mati lɔnnilae xa marasi ra,
i bɔɲɛ rabi n ma masenyie bɛ.
A lan i xa e ragata i sondonyi kui,
e naxa makuya i dɛ ra.
N wama i rasife nɛ to lɔxɔɛ,
alako i xa i yɛtɛ taxu Alatala ra.
N bara taali tongo saxan sɛbɛ i ma,
naxee findixi marasi nun lɔnni ra i bɛ,
alako i xa nɔndi xɔri yati kolon,
i fan xa sa na iba i xɛɛma bɛ.
I naxa setare rahalaki i xa kɔbiri sɔtɔ,
i naxa tɔɔrɔmixi tɔɔɲɛgɛ,
barima Alatala tan e xun mafalama nɛ,
a fa tɔɔrɔmixie yaxuie tɔɔrɔ.
I naxa bira mixi bɔɲɛ gbe fɔxɔ ra,
naxan xɔnɔxi tɛmui birin,
xa na mu a ra i fan darima nɛ na mɔɔli ra,
na fa findi gantanyi ra
i suxuma naxan na.
I naxa lu mixie ya ma naxee taanima e booree bɛ,
naxee se dɔxɔma sɛɛkɛ ra mixie bɛ,
xa na mu a ra e i xa sade raminima nɛ i bun ma,
a fa li kɔbiri mu na i yi ra i xa a fi.
I naxa i babae xa naaninyi matɔnxuma saxi ba e yire de.
Walikɛ naxan fata a xa wali ra,
mangɛe nan hayi luma a ma.
A mu walima setaree bɛ.
